selection_rule: On cropped images at long side 256, select gradient magnitude <= image's 20th percentile, excluding a two-pixel border
observations: Selections include dark empty regions in many black-background examples.
Selections also include smooth interiors of poppy seeds and semolina, especially on white backgrounds.
This is an appearance control, not verified background-only segmentation.
decision: Retain as diagnostic control, exclude from visual-model winner selection; do not attribute its score solely to background
